_comment: ENGINEERING_ONLY host-qualification variant. Identical to the qualified capture-host config except that every runtime artifact is written into the engineering namespace on the Linux filesystem, outside the repository, where no P0/P1/P2 or production artifact discovery can reach it. The qualified Experiment III capture host: WSL2 Ubuntu 26.04, headless Xvfb + Mesa llvmpipe software rendering, no GPU, no MineWorld. The runtime tree lives on the Linux-native filesystem because Java/Minecraft filesystem locking and latency differ under /mnt/c. Paths are host data, never source.
